question: Should nix-openclaw require ByteRover to publish reproducible dependency metadata, or adopt and maintain a ByteRover-specific Nix artifact?
rationale: The generic plugin interface already exists; the unresolved choice is whether the repository should assume ongoing packaging ownership for a third-party context engine that does not meet the normal immutable dependency contract.

options.title: Require upstream package fix
options.body: Ask ByteRover to publish `npm-shrinkwrap.json` or bundled runtime dependencies, after which users can configure it through `runtimePluginSources`.

options.title: Adopt ByteRover artifact
options.body: Add a pinned repository-owned ByteRover package, expose it through supported runtime plugin outputs, and maintain its dependency updates and checks.

recommendation.title: Require upstream package fix
recommendation.body: Ask ByteRover to publish `npm-shrinkwrap.json` or bundled runtime dependencies, after which users can configure it through `runtimePluginSources`.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly routed into this specific issue and are the strongest available owner for coordinating the support-boundary decision.
